additional_info.subject: Handover to L3
additional_info.body:
• Problem Description: Transactions deducting multiple amounts from customers account for
vjvgSy, SiOt0o. Please see case description for the amounts getting deducted.
• Action Performed: Analysed logs for all the transactions on SCB. We see that the SCB shows that the request for partial reversal gets triggered, and after a couple of seconds the reversal gets successful processed, however, we see an “unexpected error” during the partial reversal. The sequence of events seen are also correct, i.e. the partial reversal message appears after the request is sent, but as soon as the partial reversal message is successful, we see the unexpeceted error.
• Charger SW Version: 6.1.3
• Reason for Handover: Troubleshooting, deep dive into logs.
• Fault history: NA
• Log analysis with timestamp: All logs attached for all the transactions
